messages:
julia: Quick report — reproducible bundler ordering footgun with rollup + rollup-plugin-esbuild + @rollup/plugin-commonjs when targeting edge workers. Default import from our SDK ends up undefined and types vanish in the bundled app.

max: ugh. repro steps?

julia: Minimal monorepo repro:
1) packages/sdk/package.json -> name: @redwood/sdk, main: dist/index.cjs.js, module: dist/index.esm.js, types: dist/index.d.ts
2) packages/sdk/src/index.ts -> export default function predict(){ return 'ok' }
3) apps/edge/rollup.config.js -> plugins: [nodeResolve(), esbuild({ target: 'es2022' }), commonjs(), terser()] and build output target: 'webworker'
4) apps/edge/src/worker.ts -> import predict from '@redwood/sdk'; add fetch handler that calls predict()

Observed: runtime on edge emu -> TypeError: predict is not a function. Inspecting bundle shows rollup emitted a require wrapper for sdk and no __esModule interop helper:
```
var sdk = require('./index.cjs.js');
exports.default = sdk.predict;
```
but inside index.cjs.js the export shape is module.exports = { default: [Function] } so the wrapper ends up pointing at undefined. Also our d.ts references are missing from final artifacts (types not picked up).

kai: Does esbuild plugin change the entry shape? Maybe esbuild transpiles TS to JS, then commonjs sees something and wraps. The order matters.

julia: Yup — when esbuild runs before commonjs, it emits ESM-ish artifacts that commonjs then wraps incorrectly. When we swap plugin order (commonjs before esbuild) the build errors out earlier but if we instead force rollup output.format = 'esm' and add package.json "exports" with import/require conditions it produces pure ESM and everything works.

max: Two obvious fixes: 1) make SDK package.json unambiguous using "exports": {"import":"dist/index.esm.js","require":"dist/index.cjs.js"} and add "types":"dist/index.d.ts" so bundlers pick types and ESM path; 2) for sampleapps, ensure rollup plugin order favors preserving ESM for edge (esbuild plugin configured with loader: 'tsx' and target matching output, and commonjs plugin configured to include/exclude workspace packages).

kai: For DX we should avoid shipping ambiguous manifests. Also add a small publish-lint that fails CI if a package has both main+module but no exports field when both builds exist. That would have caught this earlier.

julia: Agreed. I tested the exports change and it fixed both default import and types mapping. I'll open PR to update the SDK package.json, add the publish-lint script, and modify the sampleapp rollup config to include a comment with the recommended plugin ordering.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-912: "rollup+esbuild+commonjs ordering breaks default imports/types for edge" and linked a tiny repro gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/repro-rollup-ordering.

max: Also add a CI smoke to sampleapp matrix: rollup+esbuild+commonjs, vite+commonjs, webpack+ts-loader. Make it fast (no e2e) but fail on build + basic runtime assertion.

julia: Will add the CI job and update onboarding doc: short checklist + example exports snippet + note about resolve.preserveSymlinks for workspace setups.

kai: Thanks — tiny follow-up: include a short example showing fallback import style `import * as sdk from '@redwood/sdk'` in the README so engineers have a quick workaround while debugging.

julia: Yup will include that. PR incoming.
